notes.title: DEVLOG 2 - More Content & Estimated Release Date!
notes.content:
The hunting system has been completed and development is now focusing on adding content and systems that build on existing ones to make them more rewarding and interesting.

[h3]BADGE SYSTEM[/h3]
One of the most important systems that have been introduced is the [b]Badge System[/b]. The player will have a menu in which a series of badges associated with various tasks will be available. When the player reaches a goal, he will be rewarded with the unlocking of the badge, the possibility of framing it to place it on the wall to create his own "trophy room" and additional rewards depending on the badge unlocked. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43120184/333caad3f124850ff60e74814c036dfb0df2739c.png[/img]

The tasks you will have to complete to unlock badges vary with various activities such as resource gathering, hunting, buying and selling and others such as "explorer badges" which you will earn by hiking through the beautiful valley and finding places of interest. 

Some of the rewards you will be able to obtain are framed badges, advanced tools, special decoration pieces or access to exclusive building locations.

In addition to in-game rewards, the player will receive a [b]Steam Achievement[/b] associated with each Badge unlocked!

[h3]MORE CONTENT[/h3]
Other systems have been added, such as the possibility of transporting objects with the car, a mechanic workshop where you can customize and improve your car, a tow truck to tow it in case you get stuck without gas in the middle of nowhere and... NPCs!

As for the NPCs, they will be mainly inhabiting the village. There will not be a deep system of relationships with them as that is not the objetive of the game, which is to live quietly away from society and build your own paradise in the mountains. 

The NPCs will offer services to the player, you will be able to have small chats with them, and they will give clues to the player about interesting locations in the game world or tips on game mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43120184/b1273a4668f526c4afc769d66253efb83fc79684.png[/img]

There have also been added many interactions with the furniture and some surprises that you will discover at launch!

[h3]RELEASE DATE[/h3]
Although it is still early to establish a concrete date as some elements such as steam achievements and localization could take longer than expected, the estimated release will be early in the second half of the year, around [b]July or August[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43120184/808fbc0135568213495f1e9e1b35a2a45248f759.png[/img]

Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist so you get notified as soon as it is released!

Greetings and happy gaming!

notes.title: Evergreen - Prologue v0.1.3 + Extended Playtime
notes.content:
Here is the new update for the prologue of Evergreen!

This update includes a lot of decorative elements to customize your house and many quality of life and performance improvements.

In addition to this, the game time has been increased, as well as the starting money in order to allow you to try more furniture combinations each run. Also, since the prologue now lasts longer, the savegame function has been enabled.

[h1]Version 0.1.3[/h1]
[list]
[*] Nvidia's image scaling technology has been included. Enable this option to get an increase in FPS.
[*] Playtime extended to 90 minutes per run.
[*] Inicial money increased.
[*] Now you can save the game.
[*] Construction UI menu has been reworked.
[*] Shopping UI menu has been reworked to accomodate all the new options and making it easier to navigate between them.
[*] You can buy much more furniture to decorate your house.
[*] The furniture placement system has been reworked. Now you can place decoration pieces more freely and stack multiple pieces one on top of the other.
[*] The inventory capacity has been increased.
[*] Energy consumption rate has been reduced.
[*] Now your car uses fuel and you can use the gas station for refueling.
[*] The Player Icon in the map has been changed to an arrow to indicate the direction you are facing.
[*] Multiple decoration pieces has been added to the world.
[/list]

notes.title: DEVLOG 1 - How is the development going?
notes.content:
I would like to inform you, the players, about the status of Evergreen's development. In short, the development is going very well and you can expect a new prologue update at the end of the month.


[h3]RECEPTION AND THOUGHTS ABOUT THE PROLOGUE[/h3]
Despite the mixed reception of the prologue, I am very satisfied with its performance. The initial goal of the prologue was for players to be able to test the basics of the game for free in order to build on a solid foundation of gameplay, which is why I preferred this model to the traditional Early Access model, as I would not want players to pay for a product so early in development.


[h3]CURRENT STATUS OF THE GAME[/h3]
Currently the game has received a large amount of content for its existing systems and new ones are being developed, with most of the current attention focused on the hunting system. There has also been an improvement in many quality of life aspects which will be listed in the next update post.

The construction possibilities have been increased exponentially, with more than 100 different pieces of furniture and structures with which the construction possibilities are enormous. The UI of the store has also received a rework to make it easier to navigate between all the new options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43120184/daef91701423345bfb2af7f283214ea376ad09fc.png[/img]

The hunting system is still early in its development, paying a lot of attention to the animations and sounds in order to make shooting satisfying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43120184/30b82858e51e38eef18c2cc35054bf90c68558d5.png[/img]

Apart from this, other systems are in development but I would like to keep them secret for now and show them to you later in development. We are also trying to add small elements of interaction with objects such as furniture so that the world feels less static and more alive.


[h3]NEXT UPDATE[/h3]
A new update is planned for you to test these new features by the end of March. This update will feature the extended options in the store as well as a handful of quality of life improvements that you can read about in the future update.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43120184/808fbc0135568213495f1e9e1b35a2a45248f759.png[/img]

In closing, I would like to thank everyone who has played the prologue and taken the time to offer feedback on it, you help make the game the best it can be. I would also like to tell you that, even if I don't reply to all of you, all your feedback is read and taken into account.

Greetings and happy gaming!

notes.title: Evergreen - Prologue v0.1.2b Hotfix
notes.content:
The new update of Evergreen - Prologue contains more audio settings and an enhanced input customization to help players make the gameplay experience more suitable to them! 

[h2]Version v.0.1.2b[/h2]
[list]
[*] The number of hits necessary to chop down a tree has been reduced.
[*] Fixed a bug of the new input system that made mouse sensitivity changes too abrupt.
[/list]

notes.title: Evergreen - Prologue v0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
The new update of Evergreen - Prologue contains more audio settings and an enhanced input customization to help players make the gameplay experience more suitable to them! 

[h1]Version v.0.1.2[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed translation typo in the inventory UI.
[*] Now the UI fully adapts itself for the custom input keys the player has chosen.
[*] Now you can close the inventory, map and building menus with your chosen input key in addition to the default 'Escape' key.
[*] The keybinding menu has been expanded to include more inputs.
[*] The keybinding menu now includes the option to remap car controls.
[*] The audio settings have been expanded. 
[*] Now the keybinding and audio configuration will be saved between different gaming sessions.
[/list]

notes.title: Evergreen - Prologue v0.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
First of all, thank you all who have played the prologue of Evergreen - Mountain Life Simulator!
I hope that you enjoyed your first day in the valley!

Thank you all for leaving your feedback about the prologue, that help me make the final game the best it can be.

[h1]Version v.0.1.1[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now the day starts when the sun is higher so you have more ambient lighting.
[*] Now you can hold the Left Mouse Button to collect resources.
[*] The base velocity of the car has been lightly increased.
[*] The intensity of the car lights has been increased.
[*] A *click* sound has been added when you turn on/off the car lights.
[*] The brake lights have been improved.
[*] A reposition button has been added to the car so you can press 'R' to relocate the car in case you get stuck.
[*] A Minimap has been added to the car UI. 
[/list]
